definitions.density: (k-1)/k times k-neighbour mass / sphere volume; exclude self; no edge correction
definitions.mean_density: actual enclosed mass / sphere volume at COM-centred r50
definitions.jeans_length_comparison: L=2*r50 compared with lambda_J using mean_density
definitions.aperture: fixed physical radius R_initial/2, centred on measured COM

accuracy.scope: Energy budget on supplied samples only; no full-duration or physical-model validation.
